Christmas Tree Farm Markets

By Forest Green Market

Annually Plumpton, VIC
Get directions

About this market

We're super excited to announce that the Christmas Tree Farm Markets are returning for 2025 — bigger, better, and more magical than ever! 🎅🎁 Due to popular demand, we're hosting TWO massive weekends of festive fun! 📅 Event Dates & Times: 🗓 Saturday 29th November & Sunday 30th November 🗓 Saturday 6th December & Sunday 7th December 🕘 9am – 3pm each day 📍 Location: Melbourne Christmas Tree Farm 319 Leakes Road, Plumpton 🎄 FREE ENTRY & FREE PARKING! ✨ What's On ✨ Get ready for an unforgettable festive experience the whole family will love! 🎅 Meet Santa and capture magical Christmas memories 🎶 Live entertainment & local dance groups performing throughout the day 🎨 Kids' activities galore! Face painting, bouncy castles, animal farm & cookie/cupcake making stations 🛍 60+ indoor & outdoor stalls featuring handmade gifts, homewares, plants, treats & more 🍔 Delicious food trucks & coffee vans serving festive favourites 🌲 Pick up your very own REAL Christmas tree while you're here! 💚 Event Highlights ✅ Free entry & parking 🐾 Dog friendly ♿ Wheelchair accessible 🎵 Entertainment for all ages 🚗 Only 30 minutes from the city 🌳 Enjoy a walk through the largest Christmas Tree Farm in Australia This is the perfect day out to shop local, support small family businesses, and soak up the festive cheer with family and friends!

Where to find us

Christmas Tree Farm Markets 319 Leakes Road, Plumpton, VIC, 3335
